title: Stochastic bifurcation analysis via polynomial chaos: consistency and convergence of branch-approximating solutions
summary: Parameter-dependent dynamical systems that exhibit bifurcations pose significant computational challenges, as traditional continuation methods require repeated, costly simulations across large ranges of parameter values to capture sudden qualitative changes in the solution. In this work, we propose a systematic approach to reconstruct the branches of the entire bifurcation diagram in a single numerical solver leveraging generalized Polynomial Chaos (PC) expansion.
